Coordinate contract and shared-file ownership on Board with pause-project-api-v2-mini, pause-project-ui-v2-mini, pause-project-qa-v2-mini; other teams retain their assignments. Required behavior: explicit Pause project dismisses all current exact-run team members INCLUDING target lead and target db-handler, while retaining project, history, Bugs/Features, unfinished work, source/results, prior run identities and durable handoff. Persist the pause/admission barrier and exact target generation before dismissal; block automatic wake, schedule and admission while paused. Distinguish cleanup-pending from fully paused, and never falsely complete unfinished work. Cleanup requires exact-run durable receipts. Repeated/lost-response retries and concurrent replacement runs cannot double-close, kill replacements, or touch unrelated projects/sessions. Preserve useful long-lived services via existing ownership/handoff rules; unresolved handoff must not silently disappear. The target handler may stop under this explicit Pause action; current Development root and actual db-handler remain available.

Resume uses existing team chooser; preselect previous team when available as an ASSISTANT-PROPOSED default, not an owner decision. Launch fresh identities from verified retained project handoff using existing partial-launch/retry controls. Never resurrect closed runs or erase historical identities. A host cleanup consumer outside the dismissed team must be able to finish saved cleanup after target lead/handler exit; reuse existing mechanisms, no extra watcher. Preserve exact run/thread identity, task-owned groups, retirement versus closure and durable cleanup receipts.

Validation is synthetic: isolated databases, browser contexts, fake providers and private tmux sockets only. No live task/profile fixtures or credentials in logs. No Files UI, TrueNAS/Tailscale/network changes, production shutdown, unrelated closure, live deployment or self-retirement. Future release needs its own bounded order for TailOS and appropriate Mini preview. Keep UI compact with fill selection, outline hover, aligned controls and clear unknown/pending states. Report a first concrete implementation/test artifact promptly after actual-handler admission/delivery acknowledgment, then commit/tree/base, meaningful tests, evidence paths/hashes and limitations. Creation/heartbeat alone is not implementation evidence. Do not call the item Done until actual handler saves acceptance.

Avoid unrelated Queue/work-item redesign. Use existing chooser, previous-team preselection only as proposed default. Add meaningful synthetic browser checks for action/retry, keyboard/accessibility, narrow/zoom states and legacy capability; keep actual visual evidence. Report real source start before waiting on final server integration.
